widgets_values: A young woman with auburn hair walks toward the camera down the middle of a quiet tree-lined street in an old European town on a sunny morning, while the camera drifts slowly in an arc to the right around her.

The target video is a photoreal, naturally lit street film in the look of a European travel documentary, shot on a 35 mm lens with soft contrast, gentle film grain and warm morning sunlight filtering through leaves, the strip of sky between the treetops pale and bright. [Shot 1] The camera looks down the middle of a narrow street paved with grey cobbles and a smooth tarmac lane, lined on both sides by tall linden trees with dark rough trunks and dense, bright green crowns that almost meet overhead. Behind the trees stand old town houses of two and three storeys painted cream, pale yellow and soft pink, with sandstone window frames, pale blue and grey wooden shutters and heavy wooden doors. On the left pavement a dark green cast iron bench sits beside a tree, and further along a round red and blue no parking sign stands on a pole near a shop with a dark awning. On the right a tall black cast iron street lamp with a glass lantern rises beside two dark slatted benches, and a black city bicycle leans against one of them. Dappled sunlight and leaf shadows lie across the road and the pavements. A young woman in her twenties with shoulder length auburn hair walks toward the camera along the centre of the road at an easy pace. She wears a light blue denim jacket over a white top, slim black trousers and white trainers, and carries a small tan leather bag on her right shoulder. Her arms swing loosely and her face is calm, looking ahead with a faint smile. As she walks, the camera glides slowly sideways in a gentle arc to the right around her, keeping her near the centre of the frame, so the tree trunks on the left slide across the houses behind them and more of the right hand pavement, the lamp post and the benches comes into view at the edge of the frame. Her hair lifts slightly with each step, the denim jacket shifts on her shoulders and her shadow moves over the tarmac. Leaves stir faintly in the crowns and flecks of light move on the cobbles. The street stays empty apart from her, and the far end fades into soft green haze where the rows of trees meet.
Soft footsteps on tarmac, birdsong in the trees and a faint breeze through leaves.
